instructions.text: Perform cleaning per the master cleaning schedule. Food contact surfaces cleaned at start of shift, between jobs and at end of shift. Sanitise work surfaces at end of shift. Raise a corrective action immediately on visual inspection failure at end of shift. Open a CAR for areas non-conforming more than once a week. Tick C if cleaning is done, NC if not.
instructions.label: Cleaning instruction
